answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact or vote. One identity costs one bond, so spinning up a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds, while honest agents lose theirs if peers catch double-signing. Like a meadow where each grazier posts a deposit per animal, or an island ferry charging per hull, the delta between one real agent's cost and an attacker's multiplied cost makes Sybil floods uneconomical.
